plan.executiveSummary: This personalized wellness plan for a 27-year-old moderately active vegetarian female focuses on achieving weight loss and improving sleep quality. It incorporates a balanced, Indian-cuisine-inspired diet, targets a daily calorie intake of approximately 1750 kcal, and includes a structured intermediate workout routine. Emphasis is placed on consistent hydration, adequate sleep, and mindful eating habits to support overall well-being.
plan.welcomeMessage: Hello! I'm delighted to help you on your journey to better health and wellness. This plan is crafted specifically for you, a dedicated Software Engineer, to help you achieve your goals of weight loss and improved sleep. Remember, consistency and self-compassion are key!

breakfast.name: Oats with Berries & Nuts
breakfast.description: 1/2 cup rolled oats cooked with water or almond milk, topped with 1/2 cup mixed berries (strawberries, blueberries), 1 tbsp chopped almonds, and a pinch of cinnamon. Provides sustained energy and fiber.

lunch.name: Spinach & Paneer Curry with Brown Rice & Lentil Dal
lunch.description: A generous serving of homemade Palak Paneer (spinach and Indian cheese curry) with 3/4 cup brown rice and 1 cup simple Toor Dal (lentil soup). A complete meal rich in protein and complex carbs.

dinner.name: Mixed Vegetable and Chickpea Stir-fry with Whole Wheat Roti
dinner.description: Stir-fry with broccoli, bell peppers, carrots, and 1 cup chickpeas, seasoned with Indian spices. Served with 2 small whole wheat rotis. Light yet satisfying, packed with vegetables and plant protein.

snacks.name: Greek Yogurt with Apple & Walnuts
snacks.description: 1 cup plain Greek yogurt (a great vegetarian protein source) with one small apple and 5-6 walnuts. Helps curb cravings and provides healthy fats.

hydrationTips: Keep a reusable water bottle at your desk and refill it regularly.
Set reminders on your phone to drink water every hour.
Infuse water with cucumber, mint, or lemon for added flavor.
Drink a glass of water before each meal to aid digestion and satiety.

workoutPlan.title: Intermediate Full-Body Strength & Cardio for Weight Loss
warmup: 5 minutes light cardio (e.g., marching in place, jumping jacks)
Dynamic stretches: Arm circles, leg swings, torso twists
cooldown: 5 minutes light walking or gentle cycling

weeklyGoals: Drink 3.0 Liters of water daily for 7 days.
Achieve 8 hours of quality sleep per night.
Incorporate at least one new vegetable into your meals.
Take a 10-minute walk during your workday.
healthyHabits: 10-minute morning sunlight exposure (helps regulate sleep cycle)
Chew food slowly and mindfully to aid digestion and satiety.
No screens 30-60 minutes before bedtime to improve sleep quality.
Take short stretching breaks every hour during work.
Practice 5 minutes of deep breathing before bed.
foodsToPrefer: Lean plant proteins (Paneer, Lentils, Chickpeas, Tofu, Greek Yogurt)
Whole grains (Oats, Brown Rice, Quinoa, Whole Wheat Roti)
Healthy fats (Almonds, Walnuts, Olive oil, Avocado)
Variety of vegetables (Bell peppers, Broccoli, Carrots)
foodsToAvoid: Excessive sodium (found in many processed foods)
plan.motivationMessage: Your dedication to your health is inspiring! Every small, consistent effort you make today is building a stronger, healthier, and happier you for tomorrow. Believe in your progress!

weeklyChallenge.title: Hydration & Movement Streak
weeklyChallenge.target: Successfully complete the 'Drink 3.0 Liters of Water' and 'Walk 8,000 Steps' daily tasks for 5 consecutive days.

progressTips: Track your water intake using an app or a marked bottle throughout the day.
Log your meals and how you feel after eating to identify patterns and preferences.
Keep a sleep journal to note bedtime, wake time, and sleep quality.
Celebrate small victories to stay motivated and reinforce positive habits.
